correctness.rationale: Every nonnegative 3x3 integer table with row/column margin n decomposes into n permutation matrices, and any permutation pair differs by at most two legal unit 2x2 switches, proving connectivity and diameter <=2n. The explicit integer potential W has rectangle increments only 0 or +/-3, and disjoint scaled three-cycle permutations differ in potential by 6n, giving equality. For nonextremal pairs, a common positive cell yields a first-layer one-switch match, and disjoint support forces matrices onto two complementary permutation supports, with a three-switch route 2P->Q+R saving one move unless both pure. Thus exactly six antipodal unordered pairs. Independently enumerated all states and full all-pairs BFS for n=1..4, obtaining 6,21,55,120 states, diameters 2,4,6,8 and six antipodal pairs in each; finite checks corroborate the all-n proof.
